retirement_reason: The consumed replacement holdout failed 22 of 24 terminal cases and is now disclosed; it is retained only as tracked regression evidence.

cases.name: Claimed handoff card
cases.prompt: Build a repo-local handoff board for a shift coordinator. The coordinator selects one ready intake card and marks it claimed. The card moves from ready to claimed, and the coordinator sees a claim receipt. Use the local duty roster as the only dependency. Never reassign a card automatically. The obsolete scratch label Juniper Comet must not enter the governed package.

cases.name: Handoff brief reordered
cases.prompt:
# Handoff brief
- Visible result: a claim receipt.
- State change: one intake card goes from ready to claimed.
- Owner and first action: the shift coordinator selects the card and marks it claimed.
- Dependency: only the local duty roster.
- Boundary: do not reassign cards automatically.
Discard the superseded note-name Quartz Ferry.

cases.name: Observation marker synthesis
cases.prompt: Three workshop observations converge on one need: a review analyst should group selected observation markers into a review set. The set changes from open to grouped and displays a decision ribbon. The marker catalog is the sole dependency. The product must not rank people and must not infer individual performance. A discarded experiment called Nickel Orchard is not part of the intent.

cases.name: Observation marker correction
cases.prompt: Initial note: a review analyst groups selected observation markers into a review set and sees a decision ribbon. Edit: keep the marker catalog as the sole dependency. Do not rank people. Do not infer individual performance. The review set moves from open to grouped. The abandoned mockup title Cobalt Thimble must be omitted.

cases.name: Workshop route missing result
cases.prompt: I need a small repo-local tool where a facilitator routes one reviewed workshop note into the follow-up lane. The facilitator owns the route, and the local lane index is available. Workshop notes may use either a compact or expanded layout. Ignore the old sketch name Linen Meteor.

cases.name: Route confirmation unspecified
cases.prompt: Create a local follow-up lane for reviewed workshop notes. A facilitator chooses a reviewed note and routes it into that lane using the local lane index. The note enters the follow-up lane. Keep all evidence inside the local repository. Exclude the retired label Velvet Sprocket.

cases.name: Packet shelf boundary
cases.prompt: Create a packet shelf for a release clerk. The clerk selects a prepared packet, places it on the reviewed shelf, and sees a shelf receipt. The packet moves from prepared to reviewed. Read only from the repo packet index. Do not send email. Do not copy packets to an external service. Remove the obsolete alias Scarlet Anvil.

cases.name: Packet shelf structured brief
cases.prompt:
## Packet shelf
Owner: release clerk
First path: choose one prepared packet, place it on the reviewed shelf, then display a shelf receipt.
State: prepared -> reviewed.
Dependency: repo packet index.
Access boundary: read-only.
Excluded behavior: never email a packet. Never copy one to an external service.
The placeholder Copper Parasol is superseded.

cases.name: Queue digest evidence merge
cases.prompt: Document one reports that a digest editor repeatedly gathers chosen queue entries into a draft digest. Document two confirms that the draft becomes reviewed when the editor accepts it and that a review seal is the visible result. Use the local queue history. Use the glossary index. Do not publish the digest. Do not contact subscribers. The discarded concept phrase Indigo Trellis is evidence noise.

cases.name: Queue digest edit settles boundary
cases.prompt: Original request: a digest editor gathers chosen queue entries into a draft digest and accepts it as reviewed, producing a review seal. The digest moves from draft to reviewed when accepted. Correction: depend on the local queue history. Also use the glossary index. Do not publish the digest. Do not contact subscribers. The old campaign term Saffron Rudder is not product truth.

cases.name: Unicode résumé review
cases.prompt: Build a café résumé board for a curator. The curator attaches one résumé note to a café entry and marks the entry reviewed. The entry moves from unreviewed to reviewed. A blue review badge confirms success. Preserve accents by reading the local naïve-text index. Do not translate the text. Do not export the text. Delete the obsolete codename Brisk Lantern.

cases.name: Unicode review checklist
cases.prompt:
# Café résumé checklist
1. Curator chooses a café entry.
2. Attach one résumé note and mark the entry reviewed.
3. Show a blue review badge.
State: unreviewed -> reviewed.
Source: local naïve-text index; accents must be preserved.
Boundary: never translate the text. Never export the text.
Discard the retired phrase Marble Kite.

cases.name: Approval owner conflict
cases.prompt: Interview notes agree on the action: approve one reviewed tile. The tile moves from reviewed to approved and then displays an approval pennant. Note A identifies the facilitator as the approval owner. Note B identifies the session coordinator as the approval owner. The local tile ledger is available. Approval stays inside the local repository. The obsolete heading Ashen Violin must be dropped.

cases.name: Approval edit preserves conflict
cases.prompt: Draft: a facilitator approves one reviewed tile and sees an approval pennant. The tile moves from reviewed to approved. Edit from the second source: approval belongs only to the session coordinator. Both statements remain asserted. Use the local tile ledger. Keep approval inside the local repository. Remove the unused label Bronze Nimbus.

cases.name: Dry-run sequence brief
cases.prompt:
## Sequence preview
The planner selects one staged itinerary and generates a simulated sequence. The itinerary remains staged, and a dry-run preview is the visible result. Read the sandbox calendar snapshot. Never issue production commands. Never reserve capacity. Never contact participants. The trial label Mossy Compass is excluded.

cases.name: Dry-run sequence request
cases.prompt: Give a planner a local sequence preview. They choose one staged itinerary, generate only a simulated sequence, and see a dry-run preview while the itinerary stays staged. The sandbox calendar snapshot is read-only. The product cannot issue production commands. It cannot reserve capacity. It cannot contact participants. Omit the prototype marker Ivory Crank.

cases.name: Assembly map bounded complexity
cases.prompt:
# Assembly map
Six roles exist: collector, verifier, mapper, reviewer, coordinator, and observer. The mapper owns the first release path: select one verified fragment, attach it to the draft map, and mark the map reviewable. The draft map becomes reviewable and shows a map seal. Read the fragment shelf. Read the role roster. Read the local glossary. Read the decision log. External references may be named but never fetched. Do not notify roles. Do not modify source fragments. Do not publish the map. Retire the brainstorm phrase Plum Sextant.

cases.name: Typed intent envelope
cases.prompt:
{"product_intent":{"actor":"index steward","first_action":"choose one candidate heading and accept it","state_change":"candidate to accepted","visible_result":"acceptance glyph","dependency":"repo heading index","boundary":"no remote lookup; no automatic rewrite"}}
Research note: the superseded token Silver Oar is not part of the product.

cases.name: Thin request with bounded assumption
cases.prompt: Let a reviewer select one draft proposal, mark it ready, and see a ready marker. The proposal moves from draft to ready. Use the local proposal list. Do not notify anyone automatically. No color or symbol scheme is provided for the marker. The abandoned label Faded Pulley must not survive.

cases.name: Queue action missing owner
cases.prompt: Create a local view that turns one selected draft from draft to queued and shows a queue stamp. Use the local draft list. Never dispatch the draft. Entries may be ordered by their last modified time. Drop the placeholder phrase Golden Hinge.

cases.name: Broadcast removed by edit
cases.prompt: Draft request suggested broadcasting after acceptance. Final edit: a board keeper accepts one pending panel. The panel moves from pending to accepted and shows a local acceptance token. Do not broadcast the acceptance. Do not call any messaging service. Read the repo panel register. The discarded mock name Woven Eclipse must be excluded.

cases.name: First-step order unresolved
cases.prompt:
# Review strip
Owner: review guide.
Result: a completion notch after one source slip is registered.
State: unregistered to registered.
Dependency: local slip cabinet.
One section says to select an existing slip first. Another section says to import a new slip first. All evidence stays inside the local repository. Remove the draft title Paper Glacier.

cases.name: Non-material label choice
cases.prompt: Build a local checkpoint list for a note keeper. The keeper selects one open checkpoint, marks it complete, and sees a completion marker. The checkpoint moves from open to complete. Read the repo checkpoint ledger. No wording or icon scheme is provided for the marker. Never alter the original note text. The superseded codename Misty Ratchet must disappear.

cases.name: Preview versus release authority
cases.prompt: Evidence agrees that an operations reader selects one staged bundle and sees an action summary using the local bundle ledger. One observation says the action only previews release. Another says the same action releases the bundle immediately. The bundle remains staged during onboarding. No release behavior is executed during onboarding. Exclude the survey alias Distant Spindle.
